description: Return the public GHS (Globally Harmonized System) hazard classification for a chemical from the NIH/NLM PubChem database (keyless, public-domain data). Given a chemical name or PubChem CID, it resolves the compound and returns the GHS signal word (Danger/Warning) and the list of GHS hazard statements (e.g. 'H302: Harmful if swallowed'). If PubChem has no GHS classification on file for the compound, that is reported gracefully. This is informational public GHS classification data, not regulatory guidance or a safety data sheet - verify against an official SDS before handling any chemical.

query.description: A chemical name (e.g. 'acetone', 'aspirin') or a numeric PubChem CID.

name: chemical_hazards
